options.content: **Data since ${go_live}.** There is no backfill: charts start empty at go-live and fill as the collector runs. All times are UTC.

panels.title: Pilots online now (in region)
panels.description: v1 card 68. Pilots inside the Australian boundary polygon in the newest snapshot (network_snapshot.pilots_in_region).

targets.rawSql: SELECT pilots_in_region AS "Pilots" FROM network_history ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Pilots online now (network-wide)
panels.description: All pilots on the VATSIM network in the newest snapshot (network_snapshot.pilots_global). New panel; context for the in-region figure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pilots_global AS "Pilots" FROM network_history ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Pilots online over time
panels.description: Screenshot-only chart (pilots online over time). Pilots in region and network-wide per snapshot, averaged into buckets that follow the dashboard range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(observed_at, $__interval),
       avg(pilots_in_region) AS "In region",
       avg(pilots_global) AS "Network-wide"
FROM network_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: When are pilots and controllers online: weekdays (UTC, last 90 days)
panels.description: v1 card 94. Average number online by UTC hour of day, Monday to Friday, from snapshots. Changed from v1, which counted distinct sessions touching each hour (and used Sun/Mon/Sat as 'weekdays').

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(hour FROM observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS hour_utc,
       round(avg(pilots_in_region)::numeric, 1) AS "Pilots",
       round(avg(controllers_in_region)::numeric, 1) AS "Controllers"
FROM network_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
  AND extract(isodow FROM observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') BETWEEN 1 AND 5
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: When are pilots and controllers online: weekends (UTC, last 90 days)
panels.description: v1 card 95. Average number online by UTC hour of day, Saturday and Sunday, from snapshots. Changed from v1 (session-overlap counts) to average concurrent users.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(hour FROM observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS hour_utc,
       round(avg(pilots_in_region)::numeric, 1) AS "Pilots",
       round(avg(controllers_in_region)::numeric, 1) AS "Controllers"
FROM network_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
  AND extract(isodow FROM observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') IN (6, 7)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Departure board
panels.description: v1 card 138. Pilots whose flight plan departs the chosen airport (default YSSY) and who were seen in the last 3 hours, newest first within status. Changed from v1: no invented gate or 'ON TIME' columns; status is derived from ground speed (60 kt or more = airborne, the same threshold as airborne minutes).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign AS "Flight",
       COALESCE(arrival, 'N/A') AS "Destination",
       status AS "Status",
       COALESCE(deptime, 'N/A') AS "Planned departure (UTC)",
       gs_kt AS "Speed (kt)",
       alt_ft AS "Altitude (ft)",
       COALESCE(flight_rules, 'N/A') AS "Rules",
       COALESCE(aircraft_icao, 'N/A') AS "Aircraft",
       last_seen AS "Last seen"
FROM (
  SELECT l.*,
         CASE WHEN NOT l.is_online THEN 'LOGGED OFF'
              WHEN l.gs_kt >= 60 THEN 'AIRBORNE'
              WHEN l.gs_kt > 0 THEN 'TAXIING'
              WHEN l.gs_kt = 0 THEN 'ON GROUND'
              ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS status,
         CASE WHEN NOT l.is_online THEN 5
              WHEN l.gs_kt >= 60 THEN 4
              WHEN l.gs_kt > 0 THEN 3
              WHEN l.gs_kt = 0 THEN 1
              ELSE 6 END AS status_rank
  FROM pilot_latest l
  WHERE l.departure = upper(btrim(${airport:sqlstring}))
) b
ORDER BY status_rank, last_seen DESC
LIMIT 25
